sourceRepository.revisionNote: Each included source and analysis artifact is pinned by SHA-256 below; a clean source commit matching this manuscript snapshot was not established.

reviewStatus.manuscript: a separately reviewed source snapshot is closed_with_limits; the packaged author-designated manuscript has its own pinned SHA-256

reproducibilityLimits: The public package includes exact Qwen request payloads and aggregate reviewed Qwen results, but not the per-request Qwen raw response archive or normalized per-request predictions. Qwen row-level scoring cannot be regenerated from this package alone.

The exact gpt-oss request payloads and raw response bodies are included. The server-side gpt-oss ledger and private service metadata are not included; transport status and response digests are preserved per request.
Full simulator reruns and fresh model inference are outside this package. Temperature-zero requests did not guarantee byte-identical re-sends.

The manuscript is the exact version at the author-designated manuscript path when assembled. It differs from a separately reviewed shorter manuscript snapshot; this package does not imply the latter is the same source revision.
